description: This file defines API handlers for authentication-related routes in the Focalboard server, including login, logout, registration, and password change, with session management and security checks.

methods.name: registerAuthRoutes
methods.description: Registers authentication routes (/login, /logout, /register, etc.) to the provided mux.Router.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates, and returns a token.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout requests, terminates the session.

methods.name: handleRegister
methods.description: Handles new user registration, validates input, and creates a user.

methods.name: handleChangePassword
methods.description: Allows changing a user's password given valid old and new passwords.

methods.name: sessionRequired
methods.description: Wraps handlers to require an active session.

methods.name: attachSession
methods.description: Attaches session info to request context based on token or headers.

methods.name: adminRequired
methods.description: Wraps handlers to require local unix connection for admin operations.
